theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tdc_cone_set_finite_planes
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid P)), IsClosed S → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s • x ∈ S) → (∀ p ∈ S, p ≠ 0 → ∃ (δ : ℝ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), 0 < δ ∧ Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 ∧ S ∩ ball p δ = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball p δ) → ∃ (q : ℕ) (Ps : Fin q → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), (∀ i, Module.finrank ℝ (Ps i) = 2) ∧ (∀ i j, i ≠ j → Ps i ⊓ Ps j = ⊥) ∧ ∀ x ∈ S, x ≠ 0 → ∃ i, x ∈ Ps i
